name: Spotify: Music and Podcasts

changelog: Ongoing changes and improvements; keep updates turned on.

summary: The Spotify APK is the official Android app for Spotify, the music, podcast and audiobook streaming service. Google Play updated it on November 23, 2026, and the version varies by device. It's free with ads, and Spotify Premium removes ads and adds offline downloads.
metaDescription: Spotify APK download for Android: get the official Spotify app from Google Play, with free vs Premium, offline listening, install steps and fixes.

faq.a: Offline downloads need Spotify Premium. Download playlists, albums and podcasts on Wi-Fi, then listen without a connection. Free users can download some podcasts.
The official Spotify app from Google Play is safe. Protect your account with a strong password, and avoid unofficial Spotify copies that promise free Premium: Spotify suspends accounts that use them.
Check your connection, update the app, and clear Spotify's cache in its settings. If it's not working in the car, re-pair Bluetooth or Android Auto. Spotify outages are shown on its status page.

faq.q: Spotify vs YouTube Music: which is better?
faq.a: Spotify has more polished playlists, podcasts and audiobooks. YouTube Music has live versions, covers and music videos, and is included with YouTube Premium.
